item.title: Paver: Tidy Up Together
item.description:
Title: Paver: Tidy Up Together
Genre: Casual , Indie , Simulation
Developer: Games Together
Publisher: Games Together , Gamersky Games
Release Date: Sep 18, 2026




About This Game

Paver: Tidy Up Together is a satisfying first-person organizing game where you sort and place pavers to rebuild a plaza. Work at your own pace, follow the correct patterns, unlock useful skills, and watch a chaotic area gradually transform into a perfectly restored plaza.

Game Modes

Play solo or together in online co-op .

  • Normal Mode : Progress normally and unlock new skills as you play.

  • Sandbox Mode : Jump straight in with all the skills unlocked.

  • No-Skill Mode : Challenge yourself with all skills disabled and complete the layout manually.

Paver Layout Plan

The restoration of the old castle is nearly complete—but the grand plaza is still unfinished. During the renovation, all pavers are mixed across the ground. Fortunately, you have the original paver layout plan . Your task is to place 4,064 pavers in the correct places. There are pavers with different colors, and also different shapes like rectangle, square, octagon, trapezoid, H-shaped, triangle, hexagon, trihex, and radial.

Skills

  • Highlighting Paver Layout: Highlights the correct place for the topmost paver in your hand

  • Auto-Placement: Automatically places your pavers in the correct places

  • Auto-Collect: Automatically collects the same pavers as the topmost paver in your hand

item.title: Nightwater
item.description:
Title: Nightwater
Genre: Adventure , Casual , Indie , Simulation , Strategy
Developer: Studio Ashty
Publisher: Studio Ashty , Irox Games
Release Date: Sep 18, 2026




About This Game

A new reality materializes. You find yourself on a solitary island, floating on a sea of liquid void and starlight, ringed by impassable mountains. This world is a mysterious place, yet strangely familiar.

Welcome to Nightwater , where you must master a new reality. Transform raw resources from simple sticks and stones into an industrial factory. Progress your technology through the ages, from primitive tools to modern machines and beyond. Expand the island by manifesting new biomes into existence to harvest their unique resources. Master multiple minigames to unlock powerful buildings and receive strong buffs.

All your efforts serve a single purpose: to reach the Lighthouse and uncover its secrets.

Nightwater is a game about gathering, collecting, and managing resources. There are multiple unique biomes, each with its own resources and secrets to unveil. Every resource features its own progression: gather by hand or automate with machines to hit each resource’s milestone goals and unlock new buildings, crafts, and powerful buffs. Explore every biome to discover 20+ resources and gain access to 100+ buildings, crafts, and buffs.

It’s fun to gather resources yourself, but it’s even more fun to build machines that do the work for you! Choose from 60+ buildings to construct farmers, assemblers, and storage units, link them with pipes, and automate every part of your production chain. You can build as many machines as you want and move or deconstruct them at any time without losing items. Automate all resources and their crafts, and unlock powerful late game buildings to make your factories faster, more efficient, and even bigger!

Use the time while your machines handle the work to progress in one of five unique minigames. Each minigame features its own gameplay loop, items, upgrades, and progression, unlocking new buildings, crafts, and buffs you can use outside the minigame to grow your factory and boost efficiency. The minigames are optional, but they offer fresh variety, their own sense of progression, and powerful rewards.

Nightwater tells a deep, personal story that is never handed to you. You’ll need to uncover hidden secrets, read between the lines, and piece together the clues to learn what Nightwater truly is. The story is fully optional, anyone can reach the end without engaging with it, but only players who search for the truth behind Nightwater and the Lighthouse will uncover all four endings and secret areas.

Nightwater is a game full of variety and unique content. As you play, you’ll uncover many secrets as well as experience a story that will make you question what Nightwater truly means to you.

item.title: Crown Siege
item.description:
Title: Crown Siege
Genre: Action , Casual , Simulation , Strategy
Developer: JOrbits Games
Publisher: 2 Left Thumbs
Release Date: Sep 18, 2026




About This Game

A short incremental siege game centered around growing and strengthening an army to defend your kingdom.

Seize the crown from an endless wave of enemies for your best chance at survival!

Recruit and Defend

Spawn troops to protect your kingdom. Defeat goblins and more to earn gold. Each wave pushes your defenses harder.

Upgrade the Kingdom

Earn experience, level up your units, and claim crowns to unlock upgrades that strengthen your army and your tower.

Carve Your Own Path

Battle across a fantasy land, facing unique challenges, testing your build, and conquering new realms.

Become Unstoppable

Grow stronger over time with larger armies and more powerful abilities, until even the most overwhelming hordes fall.

item.title: iRacing® Studios NASCAR 26
item.description:
Title: iRacing® Studios NASCAR 26
Genre: Racing , Simulation , Sports
Developer: iRacing.com Motorsport Simulations, LLC
Publisher: iRacing.com Motorsport Simulations, LLC
Release Date: Sep 17, 2026




About This Game

The official game of NASCAR is back and better than ever with NASCAR 26.

Battle your way through all four NASCAR National Series in Career, Quick Race, Championship, Multiplayer, or our all new mode featuring The Chase! And, with all the laser scanned assets of iRacing, the level of authenticity has never been higher with dynamic track, an all new peak performance training mode, and enhanced driving physics across every chassis. And, with our new cross-play multiplayer feature, you can take on all your friends and show them who's best!

NASCAR 26 brings all the thrills and excitement of race day, right to your living room. Are you ready to start your engine?

item.title: ENDLESS Legend™ 2
item.description:
Title: ENDLESS Legend™ 2
Genre: RPG , Simulation , Strategy
Developer: AMPLITUDE Studios
Publisher: Hooded Horse
Release Date: Sep 17, 2026
Early Access Release Date: Sep 22, 2025




About This Game

ENDLESS Legend™ 2 is a fantasy strategy game where you lead wildly varied factions as they build grand empires and wage planet-spanning wars on an ever-evolving ocean world at the brink of extinction. Cataclysmic events have wrought havoc on the natural order, and the very world will change as time goes on revealing new opportunities for exploration and conquest to the bold and daring. Establish expansive cities to spread your influence and strengthen your economy, raise armies and command troops in turn-based tactical battles to overcome your enemies by force, and push forth into the unknown to uncover the dark secrets that lie at the planet’s core.

Whether you command righteous warriors descended from the stars, cursed knights seeking reprieve from their misfortune, or hive-minded beasts that know only how to fight, feed, and propagate, ENDLESS Legend™ 2 features vastly different factions each driven by their own philosophies, histories, capabilities, and narratives. Each of the factions have unique traits that set them apart from one another whether on the battlefield, in matters of commerce, with regards to empire-building, or in diplomatic affairs – it is up to you to adapt to their strengths and weaknesses and build strategies and distinct playstyles.

  • The choice of faction will influence every aspect of the game. Will you prefer to benefit from a constant state of fighting, untethered by the need to justify your wars, spawning additional warriors with each victorious battle to grow endlessly in strength? Will you choose to benefit from cohabitation and cooperation, spreading tendrils of influence throughout the world to build a network of allies, leveraging relationships with the minor factions of the planet to further enrich your empire? Or will you lead a people who feed upon their own kind for sustenance, taking advantage of a unique economy free from the needs of mere mortals? Learn what makes each faction distinct and use it to your advantage whether you’re leading them, or looking to destroy them. Or venture beyond the existing factions by making your own — mix and match affinities, traits, units, and populations from across the game to explore the world with your own creation.

  • Military doctrine varies greatly between the factions, providing unique opportunities for a capable commander to gain an advantage over their foe, even when out of combat. Build massive fortifications to defend cities and establish connections to powerful weapon and support systems waiting in orbit as the martial Kin of Sheredyn. Invest in the spread of coral so the spiritualist Aspects are able to support themselves outside of friendly territory. Dot the land with nests and burrows to quickly traverse vast distances and ambush enemies from beneath as the Necrophage hive.

  • Either auto-resolve combat or take direct control of individual units within your armies when battle begins, using the surrounding terrain to your advantage as you seek out chokepoints, cover, and the high ground. Apart from having faction-specific units, traits, weapons, and attributes, each faction also features special battlefield abilities that can turn the tide of battle if properly utilized. Where one faction might work best with a patient commander, able to meticulously maneuver troops to secure powerful adjacency bonuses, another might rely on force of numbers and overwhelming strength.

  • Recruit heroes and watch them grow over time as they gain new traits to bolster their abilities, build relationships that provide them with various boons, and acquire equipment useful both in and out of battle. Powerful commanders, properly trained and armed, can turn the tide of entire wars when wisely utilized.

Empires will rise and fall based on their ability to adapt to a changing world. Starting from a single humble city, expand according to your faction's unique strengths and limitations while adapting to the periodic monsoons and tidefalls. Build districts around your cities’ central structures, exploit strategic and luxury resources littered around the world, and develop your technological capabilities and industrial might.

  • Cataclysmic tidefalls will expose new opportunities and threats as the oceans recede to unveil new land ripe for expansion. While your existing territory will remain unscathed, the newly revealed terrain from the retreating oceans will open up new avenues of approach for you and your enemies, alongside new resources to exploit and new anomalies to explore. While this can fundamentally change the strategic value of various locations as time goes on, a wise leader will plan for the inevitable – will you prepare to expand into new lands as soon as a tidefall occurs, or focus on shoring up your defenses where you anticipate new landbridges to appear?

  • Plan the development of your cities to focus on population growth, industrialization, and commerce, or prioritize their contribution to the sciences, your empire’s influence, and your military might – the choice is yours based on the needs of your burgeoning empire. Establish districts that provide fortifications or further the production of various resources, take advantage of adjacency and terrain bonuses, and pursue technological advancements that allow you to upgrade established districts or unlock entirely new options. Will you patiently seek out ideal locations to establish long-term economic hubs and military strongholds, or will you spread rapidly to secure new lands and increased productivity ahead of your enemies?

  • The lands around you are teeming with both opportunity and danger alike. Crush the weaker minor factions littered around the world to pillage their resources, or instead cultivate friendly relations and have them join your growing empire, incorporating their distinctive units and heroes to further strengthen your people. Explore ancient ruins and strange anomalies, braving the dangers of the unknown to enrich your lands and gain powerful artifacts to wield against your enemies.

A deep mystery lies buried beneath the surface of this once-tranquil ocean world, where an ancient power stirs in the darkness. Gain dominion over the planet through violent conquest, seek victory through diplomatic and technological advancements, pursue quests and tackle events that can alter the course of a campaign, or empower your sworn heroes to unveil the story of your people – the choice is yours.

Will you be a ruthless conqueror or a cunning builder? A cultivated diplomat or a flesh-eating beast? Will you bring harmony back to the planet, seeking out lost legends and heroes, or will you defy the fate that drives your faction and carve a legend of your own?

System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows® 10 (64-bit)
    • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-4430 (quad-core) / AMD® FX-Series™ FX-8350 (quad-core)
    • Memory: 8 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 960 (4 GB) / AMD® Radeon™ RX 5500 XT (8 GB)
    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Storage: 20 GB available space
    Recommended:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows® 11 (64-bit)
    • Processor: Intel® Core™ i7-6700 (quad-core) / AMD® Ryzen™ 5 1500X (quad-core)
    • Memory: 12 GB RAM
    • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1070 (8 GB) / AMD® Radeon™ RX 5700 XT (8 GB)
    • DirectX: Version 12
    • Storage: 20 GB available space
    • Additional Notes: SSD Recommended
